dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Newly diagnosed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS (SNOMED 109969005; ICD-10-CM C83.30)

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: Cell of origin by Hans is non-germinal-center (ABC-like), an adverse prognostic feature.

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: NOT a recurrence, metastasis or nodal metastasis of her 2016 left breast carcinoma: the tumor is CD20/PAX5 positive ... cytokeratin AE1/AE3 and GATA3 are negative in lesional cells

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor / Lugano stage III with splenic involvement and B symptoms (stage IIIB-S).

stage_spleen_lymphatic.quote: spleen counts as an extranodal (S) site.

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms present: recurrent unexplained evening fever to 38.4 C and drenching night sweats 2-3 times weekly for ~5 weeks

stage_bulk_definition.quote: Largest mass 7.5 cm = high-volume disease but NOT bulky by Lugano criteria (bulky = >=10 cm).

mn_stage_iv.quote: Ann Arbor / Lugano stage III with splenic involvement and B symptoms (stage IIIB-S).

mol_del_not_dh.quote: FISH on 200 nuclei (2026-09-08) shows NO MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement, so this is NOT high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements (double-hit)

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: this is NOT high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements (double-hit) and not triple-hit

mn_da_epoch.quote: I am explicitly NOT choosing DA-EPOCH-R (no MYC/BCL2 rearrangement, so no double-hit indication; Alliance showed no survival advantage over R-CHOP in high-risk non-double-hit DLBCL

prog_ipi_2.quote: IPI = 3 (age <60 = 0, stage III-IV = 1, LDH 510 elevated = 1, ECOG 1 = 1, <=1 extranodal site = 0) = high-intermediate risk.

prog_cns_ipi_2.quote: CNS-IPI = 3 (LDH elevated 1, ECOG 1 = 1, stage III-IV = 1; age <60 0, eGFR 85 0, albumin 3.8 0, extranodal sites <=1 0) = intermediate CNS risk.

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: give CNS prophylaxis with intrathecal methotrexate 12 mg on day 1 of cycles 1, 2 and 3, because intermediate CNS-IPI is compounded here by high tumor burden

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: give CNS prophylaxis with intrathecal methotrexate 12 mg on day 1 of cycles 1, 2 and 3, because intermediate CNS-IPI is compounded here by high tumor burden (7.5 cm, SUVmax 22)

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: CARDIAC SAFETY - she has received 240 mg/m2 of doxorubicin in 2016 with left breast tangential radiotherapy, and her LVEF has fallen from 62% (2016) to 45%

mn_standard_dox_ignores_heart.quote: I will give R-CHOP x 6 cycles with pegfilgrastim, with (i) doxorubicin dose reduction and/or cardiology-directed modification if cardiology advises

tx_cardio_onc_referral.quote: Before cycle 1 I will add a cardiology/cardio-oncology opinion on whether the EF decline is partly reversible

tx_cardioprotection.quote: (iii) an ACE inhibitor/ARB added for blood pressure (<130/80) and LV support.

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: POLATUZUMAB VEDOTIN + R-CHP (no anthracycline) for 6 cycles (21-day cycles)

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: omitting anthracycline removes the largest modifiable cardiotoxicity risk ... without compromising cure probability in her risk group

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: repeat echocardiogram with GLS every 2 cycles and after the final cycle.

mn_non_curative.quote: She is fit for curative-intensity therapy: ECOG 1, independent in all activities

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT 6-8 weeks after the last cycle (approximately May 2027): Deauville 1-3 = complete metabolic response and observation; Deauville 4-5 = biopsy any residual FDG-avid lesion before escalating

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: uric acid, potassium and creatinine with allopurinol in cycles 1-2 for tumor lysis risk (formally low: urate 5.8, normal renal function, no kidney involvement) and hydration

sup_gcsf.quote: pegfilgrastim 6 mg SC on day 9 of every cycle (mandatory with polatuzumab/R-CHP in POLARIX; also indicated by her age, IPI and prior cytotoxic therapy)

sup_anastrozole.quote: Anastrozole: CONTINUE to complete her planned 10-year course in November 2026 - there is no interaction with polatuzumab/R-CHP

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: viral serologies 2026-09-01 - HBsAg, total anti-HBc, anti-HBs, HCV Ab and HIV-1/2 Ag/Ab all non-reactive (so no antiviral prophylaxis is required

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: She is fit for curative-intensity therapy: ECOG 1, independent in all activities, still working her usual full-time hours as a school librarian

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: No cardiology/cardio-oncology consultation or documented surveillance plan; no NT-proBNP or hs-troponin; no MUGA; no baseline strain comparator (2016 study did not perform GLS), so the LVEF fall from 62% to 45% cannot be confidently attributed to anthracycline versus hypertension versus occult cardiomyopathy
